trust_decision.summary: Text-mode atom values (\text{}, \mbox{} bodies) and delimiter values parsed from untrusted LaTeX are interpolated unescaped as element content into HTML markup (Box.toMarkup) and MathML strings (atomToMathML/scanText), which callers assign to innerHTML.

landing_point.why: The summary names convertLatexToMarkup and \text{}; the HTML body string is built from box.value in Box.toMarkup, which sits next to the existing sanitizeAttributeValue helpers.

fix_sites.entry_point: convertLatexToMathMl() mord / \char (entity emission changed to literal char)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/formats/atom-to-math-ml.ts:265-276 and src/formats/atom-to-math-ml.ts:1122-1131 (MathML output, a separate serializer from the HTML Box renderer; reached by <math-span> hidden MathML at src/public/math-static-elements.ts:394-407 and renderMathInElement at src/addons/static-render.ts:216-220)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: MathML is an accessibility side-output rendered in a visually hidden container, and the report's example is convertLatexToMarkup; a solver can argue the visible HTML renderer is the only XSS sink. For the speakable-text route: it is opt-in (default renderAccessibleContent is 'mathml', src/addons/static-render.ts:476) and is 'plain text for a screen reader', not markup.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Enabling & escaping in xmlEscape double-escapes the MathML entity strings the mord/\char path already emits ('&#x...;' passed through xmlEscape at line 984), so \char and non-Latin identifiers break unless converted to literal code points; likewise HTML Box output must keep a literal '&' rendering as & (snapshot '#%&$') without double-escaping, and existing entity constants (SPECIAL_IDENTIFIERS, SPECIAL_ACCENTS,  ) must stay unescaped.

O6_input_shapes: single text-mode atom outside a run (atomToMathML text branch)
delimiter values: \left< / \right>, \bigl<, genfrac delims, array environment delims
literal & (must be escaped once, not double-escaped)

O7_producer.where: src/formats/atom-to-math-ml.ts:592-603 (toString/xmlEscape) and src/formats/atom-to-math-ml.ts:257-276 (scanText); text values originate from the LaTeX parser into Atom.value

O8_uncovered_routes.route: renderMathInElement with renderAccessibleContent containing 'speakable-text' assigns convertLatexToSpeakableText output to innerHTML; text-mode atom values are concatenated raw into that string.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Opt-in accessibility option (default is 'mathml' at src/addons/static-render.ts:476); speakable text looks like plain text/SSML, not a rendering path; the fix and advisory mention only markup and MathML.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (src/addons + src/formats/atom-to-speakable-text.ts:231,280,539) from landing point src/core/box.ts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public convertLatexToSpeakableText() returns text-mode values raw (and inside SSML when textToSpeechMarkup='ssml'), so an application inserting it as HTML/SSML gets the same unescaped \text body.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Function is documented as producing 'textual representation ready to be spoken'; escaping is arguably the caller's job.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: mpunct emits `command` raw into <mo separator>; a parser path that keeps user punctuation as command would reflect it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring cases already interpolate atom.command/atom.body raw, so a maintainer copying the pattern would not escape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: \operatorname body inserted as atom.body raw into <mo>.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The scanIdentifier \operatorname path escapes via toString, but this fallback branch does not; same concept, different function.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: variant-mapped identifier emitted unescaped when mathVariantToUnicode returns a mapped string.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A mapper table extension returning non-letter characters would bypass xmlEscape; a producer deep in internal machinery.

O9_family: XSS / improper output encoding (CWE-116/CWE-79) into HTML and MathML element content

O10_build.project_tests: test/security.test.ts (Unsecure Content), test/markup.test.ts snapshots, test/static-elements.test.ts; jest runs SSR conversion functions without a browser

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape only box.value in Box.toMarkup (HTML path) and stop, leaving MathML text/delims and speakable-text raw; or flip xmlEscape to escape & and break \char entity output.

out_of_scope_notes: Box htmlStyle value at src/core/box.ts:506-511 is only checked by sanitizeAttributeValue quoting; CSS-value injection is a different property, not pursued.
Editor aria-live / speech paths (src/editor/a11y.ts, src/editor/speech.ts) not checked for HTML sinks.
